item.title: No deaths after plane crashes on beach shore near Somalia airport
item.description: A plane overran the runway at Somalia's main airport and ended up in shallow water at a nearby beach Tuesday during an emergency landing.

item.title: Olympic athletes' medals break during celebrations at the Winter Olympics
item.description: Handle with care. That's the message from gold medalist Breezy Johnson at the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics after she and other athletes, including Alysa Liu, found their medals broke within hours.

item.title: US skater Maxim Naumov makes an emotional Olympic debut one year after losing parents in plane crash
item.description: One of the last conversations Naumov had with his parents was about what it would take to make the Olympics.

item.title: Super Bowl averages 124.9M viewers in US, Bad Bunny's halftime 128.2 million, both short of records
item.description: Sunday night's Super Bowl and Bad Bunny fell short of setting records for most watched U.S. broadcast and halftime show.

item.title: ICE chief defends his officers' actions before Congress after the deaths of 2 protesters
item.description: The head of Immigration and Customs Enforcement is defending his officers, saying they won't be intimidated while carrying out President Donald Trump's deportation agenda.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Downpours continue tonight; gusty winds in higher elevations
item.description: Rain will continue to overspread the Bay Area for the rest of today and tonight. Gusty south winds will accompany the rainfall, especially in the higher elevations. There will be some downpours today and tomorrow as the system stalls.

item.title: San Francisco expands program to help unhoused find their way back home
item.description: For years, San Francisco has funded a program to send those who are unhoused back home. Now, the city is trying something new. Here's a closer look at the expanded Journey Home program.

item.title: Dancing with the Stars Con brings ballroom magic to Palm Springs for the first fan convention
item.description: Dust off your dancing shoes! The first-ever Dancing with the Stars Con is coming to Palm Springs this summer. Featuring pros, judges and stars like Robert Irwin and JoJo Siwa, this three-day event is the ultimate fan experience. Tickets go on sale Feb. 14.

item.title: Alameda County delays vote on Flock license plate reader contract amid privacy concerns
item.description: Supervisors opted to push the decision to April 21, citing unresolved questions about data privacy and government access to surveillance information.

item.title: Kate Hudson, Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning among Oscars Nominees Luncheon attendees
item.description: It's the most exclusive lunch in Hollywood! We're taking you inside the 2026 Oscars Nominees Luncheon with nominees like Kate Hudson, Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning and more. Watch "The Oscars" LIVE Sunday March 15 on ABC and Hulu.
